text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PD incident fired (P2) — inference-eu-prod: elevated 5xx rate on model-pool eu-inference-1. PagerDuty incident: INC2470012345. Auto-escalation to dev-oncall.

devon: ack — I'm on it, jumping in.

devon: quick snapshot — 5m 5xx rate = 4.2%, p95 latency = 1.2s, QPS ~350 for the pool. Errors spike started ~2m ago.

maria: noticed same in dashboards, looks concentrated on requests to model variant `m-small-q4` in EU region. Possible cold-start storm?

devon: checking pods and pods logs now.

devon: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=pool=eu-inference-1
NAME                                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-eu-1-xxxxx                2/2     Running   0          12d
inference-eu-2-xxxxx                0/2     CrashLoop 3          3m
inference-eu-3-xxxxx                2/2     Running   0          1d
```

devon: logs show repeated OOM-ish traces from gpu-worker around model load: 
```
E OOMError: Failed to allocate 1.5G for quantized kernel
...
```

samir: hmm. Could be memory pressure during model swap. We can evict failing pod and force fallback to `m-small-q3` variant while we stabilize. That should reduce mem footprint.

alice: heads-up — I'm mid-rotation (next oncall) but available to take ownership if you need to hand off. I can run the fallback routing and increase pool replicas.

devon: request handoff to alice — I need to finish an immediate hotfix in another region and won't be available for sustained follow-up. @alice, can you claim ownership? Please note customer impact in PD notes: some customers see 502/504, approx 2.8% of global requests, concentrated EU.

alice: I got it, taking ownership. Claiming INC2470012345. Updating PD incident notes now.

alice: plan —
1) set pool fallback policy to prefer `m-small-q3` for new requests
2) scale eu-inference-1 from 4 -> 6 replicas temporarily
3) cordon + replace the crashlooping node

alice: applying fallback routing (api call):
```bash
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/v1/pools/eu-inference-1/fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -d '{"preferred_variant":"m-small-q3","timeout_s":30}'
```

alice: scaling replicas now:
```bash
kubectl scale deployment eu-inference-1 --replicas=6 -n inference
```

ops-bot: action accepted — scaling eu-inference-1 -> 6 replicas. Will monitor cluster scheduler.

devon: +1 on fallback. Also added a temporary route rule in the edge to prioritize eu-nonpeak region for heavy batches.

samir: I'll watch mem metrics; if OOM persists we should trigger a model rollback to earlier build sha.

alice: scale command returned OK, new pods creating. Reconfigured fallback routing. Patch applied to PD notes: "fallback -> m-small-q3; scaled to 6; cordon failing node planned".

alice: monitoring — 1m after change: 5xx rate down to 1.0%, p95 -> 420ms. QPS stable.

maria: customers reporting improvement via status page; one enterprise reported intermittent errors but confirmed reduced impact.

devon: nice work. I'll hand off the Slack thread to you for follow-up. In PD, set incident owner to alice and add postmortem owners: devon + samir.

alice: confirmed ownership in PD and Slack. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then we can decide on rollback vs hotfix.

samir: noted — I'll prepare rollback PR incase fallback and scale don't hold.

alice: small ask — please add any preserved logs to the PD incident so SRE can correlate with autoscaler events.

devon: added logs + kube events to PD under attachments.

ops-bot: Reminder — escalation window set for 27m from now.

alice: setting follow-up: 1) postmortem ping 24h, 2) cleanup: revert temp scale and routing after stability for 1h, 3) action item: add memory headroom to model build matrix.

maria: thanks all. :thumbsup:

alice: closing this Slack thread for now — remaining discussion will be in PD incident and a follow-up thread for the postmortem. If anything regresses ping me directly.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status -> mitigated; assigned to alice; next update scheduled in 25m.
